name: Exchange Online Protection (EOP)
short_description: The baseline filtering service included with every Exchange Online mailbox, covering spam, malware, connection filtering and core anti-phishing with spoof protection.

evidence.quote: At the bottom is Exchange Online Protection or EOP. Every exchange online mailbox gets it. It handles the basics spam
What exactly is exchange online protection?
Exchange online protection or EOP is the built in email security layer that comes with every Microsoft 365 plan.
